note: Approximate 2024/25 statutory parameters compiled for gameplay; not tax advice. Archetype templates stand in where a country is not modelled in detail.

USA.label: United States 2024 (federal income tax, single filer; sales tax as VAT; approximate)

DEU.label: Germany 2024 (approximate; Tarif 2024 fitted by chord rates, solidarity surcharge ignored)

FRA.label: France 2024 (approximate; single, no quotient familial, 10% employment deduction ignored)

JPN.label: Japan 2024 (approximate; national income tax only, resident tax and surtax ignored)

KOR.label: South Korea 2024 (approximate; national income tax, 42% and 40% brackets merged, local surtax ignored)

AUS.label: Australia 2024/25 (approximate; Stage 3 rates; employer = superannuation guarantee 11.5%, a funded private contribution)

CAN.label: Canada 2024 (approximate; federal income tax only, provincial taxes ignored; CPP/EI; combined GST/HST/PST average)

CHN.label: China 2024 (approximate; IIT comprehensive income, special additional deductions ignored)

IND.label: India FY2024-25 (approximate; new regime after July 2024 Budget, cess/surcharge/rebate ignored)

BRA.label: Brazil 2024 (approximate; IRPF table from Feb 2024, INSS employee ~11% to the 93k ceiling, VAT as an average of ICMS/PIS/COFINS/IPI/ISS)

ARG.label: Argentina 2024 (approximate; amounts are template multiples of mean earnings, rates are statutory)

MEX.label: Mexico 2024 (approximate; annual ISR table merged to 7 bands by chord rates, employment subsidy ignored)

IDN.label: Indonesia 2024 (approximate; PTKP single, BPJS; 35% band above IDR 5bn omitted)

TUR.label: Turkey 2024 (approximate; wage tariff above the minimum-wage exemption, stamp duty ignored)

EGY.label: Egypt 2024 (approximate; amounts are multiples of an assumed ~100,000 pound mean wage, rates statutory)

VNM.label: Vietnam 2024 (approximate; amounts are multiples of an assumed ~8m dong a month mean wage, rates statutory)

POL.label: Poland 2024 (approximate; 30,000 tax-free amount, 12%/32%, ZUS plus 9% health)

CHL.label: Chile 2024 (approximate; global complementary tax with UTA ~ 790,000 pesos, AFP contributions)

RUS.label: Russia 2024 (approximate; 13%/15% personal income tax, unified insurance contributions paid by employers)

SAU.label: Saudi Arabia 2024 (approximate; no personal income tax, GOSI rates for nationals)

NGA.label: Nigeria 2024 (approximate; amounts are multiples of an assumed ~1.3m naira mean wage, PAYE rates statutory)

ARE.label: United Arab Emirates 2024 (approximate; no personal income tax, 9% corporate tax above AED 375,000)

NOR.label: Norway 2024 (approximate; 22% general income tax plus trinnskatt, merged on one base)

SGP.label: Singapore YA2024 (approximate; resident rates, CPF 20%/17% to the S$6,800 monthly ceiling, GST 9%)

CHE.label: Switzerland 2024 (approximate; federal plus average cantonal/communal stand-in, AHV/IV/EO/ALV only)

ETH.label: Ethiopia 2024 (approximate; amounts are multiples of an assumed ~7,000 birr a month mean wage, rates statutory)
